The decisive mistake was made by Poetry_Expert at Step 7. The agent claimed to quote the poem from the Poetry Foundation, but no one had retrieved that page. The search snippets only showed the first lines, so the text was reconstructed from memory and was unreliable. The agent then asserted that the third stanza contains indented lines. The correct stanza is 2, so this fabricated analysis led to the wrong final answer, and the other agents simply agreed with it.
